title: Shared documentation for meal-plan shopping list flow
description: Document the new meal-plan to shopping-list flow, the generic scaling primitive, and any developer-facing notes needed to understand duplicate-name handling, provenance formatting, and sheet-based post-create navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation explains that meal plans can now generate shopping lists from the detail view.
Developer-facing notes capture the role of `Recipe.scaled(by:)` as the canonical arbitrary-factor scaling helper.
Documentation records the duplicate-name error behavior, provenance bullet format, and sheet-based `View` flow.
Any touched docs or inline code documentation remain consistent with the shipped behavior and scope boundaries.
